content.text: {"id": "mm5922a4", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "more likely than adults with the highest family incomes to be current cigarette smokers (28.3% versus 15.1%)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the percentage of adults who had five or more alcoholic drinks in 1 day in the past year was lowest"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "to be physically inactive (57.5% versus 27.8%)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "to be obese (28.8% versus 22.1%)"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "figure 1", "q": "The figure shows the prevalence of selected unhealthy behavior-related characteristics among adults aged ≥18 years"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "U.S. adults with the lowest family incomes were more likely than adults with the highest family incomes"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "note", "q": "Estimates are age adjusted using the projected 2000 U.S. population as the standard population"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "note", "q": "Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. adult population"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "note", "q": "Estimates are age adjusted using the projected 2000 U.S. population as the standard population and three age groups"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Poverty status is based on family income and family size using the U.S. Census Bureau poverty thresholds for 2004, 2005, and 2006"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Family income was imputed when information was missing, using multiple imputation methodology."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Denominators for each percentage exclude persons with unknown behavior-related characteristics."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
